verdict: Paid campaigns are off; organic profiles also went quiet this week.
narrative: Across all three locations — Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision — paid advertising generated zero spend and zero leads over the last 28 days, meaning all measurable activity came from organic Google Business Profile engagement. Combined, the three profiles produced 358 GBP actions this period (directions, calls, and web clicks), but every profile dropped to zero GBP activity in the last 7 days, a confirmed pattern and not a data blip. The web/SEO root cause that is gating organic recovery has been identified and a fix is being submitted now, and the contact lists needed to launch outreach sequences are being pulled this week. Once those two blockers clear, outreach campaigns and SEO recovery work move into active execution, with paid campaigns to follow on a confirmed relaunch schedule.

paid ad spend across Meta and Google for the full 28-day window — campaigns are paused across all entities

watch_item.issue: All three Google Business Profiles dropped to zero engagement for 8+ consecutive days, cutting off the only active inbound source.
watch_item.fix: A listing and visibility audit is underway across all three profiles; the web/SEO root cause fix being submitted this week is expected to stabilize organic presence.
